scope: Approximate ELBO construction, rather than an exact-likelihood identity.
span: We note that the delta method for VI in non-conjugate models, proposed by Wang and Blei [47], also employs a second-order Taylor series expansion around the mean of the variational posterior distribution. However, the delta method assumes a multivariate Gaussian variational posterior and applies the Taylor expansion to the log joint density (i.e., the sum of the log-likelihood and the log prior). In contrast, our method applies the expansion to the log-likelihood, and as we will demonstrate, the optimal variational posterior is determined automatically.

span: As shown in Figure 3(a), when the features are weakly correlated, the mean-field VI (MFVI) closely approximates both the posterior distribution and the posterior mean.
